# Volume 4 timeline

## CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Small Anne Cordelia](../character/small-anne-cordelia.md)** — [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) garret about ending her teaching career, her upcoming wedding to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and moving to [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). They reminisce about past memories and discuss their plans and local gossip.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P31](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0031)_

## CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discuss [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's upcoming wedding and the gifts they plan to give. Neighbors visit to offer mixed congratulations, after which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to share details about the house he has found for them near [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).

## CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her wedding plans and guest list with Mrs. Lynde and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). In the following days, guests arrive to celebrate, including Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), who presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with Miss Patty's china dogs. On the eve of her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Matthew's grave before joining [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on a walk home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P0](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_

## CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES

**[Shirley](../character/shirley.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Small Anne Cordelia](../character/small-anne-cordelia.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Allan](../character/allan.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), Allans** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up happily on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her life in her childhood room. Family and friends gather to prepare and celebrate, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are married in the orchard. Following a joyful reception, the newlyweds leave for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) while their guests remain to comfort [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P17](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0017)_

## CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through the countryside toward their new home at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). Along the way, they admire the scenic views, pass a strikingly beautiful girl driving geese, and finally arrive at their new house.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P1](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P17](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 5 THE HOME COMING P19](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), his wife, and Captain Jim welcome [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to their new house in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). Over supper, Captain Jim shares stories of his life at the lighthouse, and the group discusses their neighbors around the harbor, including Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P16](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037)_

## CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Captain Jim tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) the romantic history of their house, detailing how its original owner, [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md), foresaw the arrival of his bride, [Persis Leigh](../character/persis-leigh.md), through a vision before her ship landed in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor). After listening to the tale and exchanging warm sentiments with his new friends, Captain Jim bids them goodnight.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P34](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0034), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md)** — Captain Jim warmly accepts Anne's invitation to visit, explaining that she belongs to "the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md)." As the evening concludes, Captain Jim and the other guests depart while admiring the moonlit harbor and Lombardy trees. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) stroll through their garden together, enjoying the peaceful night and their home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P59](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0059), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P60](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0060), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P64](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0064)_

## CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) enjoy their peaceful early autumn at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), reflecting on their idyllic honeymoon and Gilbert's professional success. Later, Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) visits, sitting on their doorstep and entertaining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with her sharp-tongued opinions and village gossip.

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — Miss Cornelia shares her sharp opinions on men, the local minister, and mutual acquaintances while visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After completing her sewing, Miss Cornelia accepts Anne's warm invitation to stay for tea.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P57](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P71](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0071), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P74](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0074), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P81](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0081)_

## CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

**A Mad Love, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), Four Winds, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Gog](../character/gog.md), [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visit Captain Jim at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, encountering the oddly bearded [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) along the lane. During their evening visit, Captain Jim explains Marshall's political vow, shares tea and stories about his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), and shows them around the lighthouse.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038)_

**[Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), A Mad Love, [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md)** — Captain Jim explains how he rescued the First Mate and shares stories about his past adventures with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). After showing off his collection of curios and telling captivating tales, Captain Jim bids them farewell, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) reflect on his remarkable life as they walk home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P51](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0051), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P57](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0057)_

## CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for an evening walk along the shore and encounters [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), whom she discovers is her striking neighbor instead of an older housewife as she had assumed. The two women converse, exchange names, and discuss their perspectives on life, though [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shows mixed feelings of warmth and emotional distance. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to recount the surprising encounter to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P4](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P51](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0051), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P58](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0058)_

## CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and recounts the tragic life story of their neighbor, [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). She explains how [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) suffered family tragedies, was coerced into marrying [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), and now lives bound to him after he returned from a sea voyage with permanent brain damage.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)_

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — Miss Cornelia asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her encounter with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) on the shore and encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persist in being Leslie's friend despite her cold demeanor. Moved by Leslie's tragic life and loneliness, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to do everything she can to win Leslie's friendship.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P39](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P41](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0041), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)_

## CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the house of dreams for a pleasant evening by the fire. She relaxes and opens up as they talk about books and offer to lend her theirs, though she abruptly retreats into sadness as she leaves. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a sweet moment discussing Leslie's beauty and Anne's hair.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P8](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P13](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P18](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0018)_

## CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through a gloomy fog to visit [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) behind while he attends a meeting in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). Upon arrival, she witnesses [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) weeping bitterly inside and decides not to intrude. On her way back, she meets Captain Jim bringing [Dick](../character/dick.md) home, and Captain Jim walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) safely back to her house.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P7](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0007)_

## CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend pleasant autumn evenings at the lighthouse with Captain Jim and [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md). Walking home afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss Leslie's potential, tease each other about past suitors, and look forward to the coming spring at their lit home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P4](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P7](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P18](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0018)_

## CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their new home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), welcoming [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), Captain Jim, and Miss Cornelia. The guests enjoy lively conversation and stories before Captain Jim heads back to the lighthouse at sunset.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P0](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

## CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) head to the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse to ring in the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) with Captain Jim. They are joined by [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), who dances with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to Captain Jim's fiddle playing. As midnight arrives, the group opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) together.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

## CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)** — During the winter at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the emotional barrier and occasional resentment she senses from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), despite their shared activities and Leslie's gift of handmade baby clothes. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his written life-book, which she realizes could be made into a great masterpiece by the right writer.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P11](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P21](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0021)_

## CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the little house, bringing spring gifts and engaging in lively debates on theology, local gossip, and neighbors. Susan Baker returns with news about an ill acquaintance, leading to a humorous exchange that causes [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Captain Jim to excuse themselves to laugh.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P21](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P52](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0052), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P57](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0057)_

## CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes into labor and gives birth to a baby girl, whom she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name Joyce. However, the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken and struggling through a painful recovery.

## CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a drive to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point), where Captain Jim comforts her over her grief for her lost baby. Captain Jim shares the tragic story of his lost sweetheart, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to remember her so her name is not forgotten.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P1](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P8](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P16](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET P19](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — Sitting in Anne's garden, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) tearfully confesses her past feelings of envy and resentment toward Anne's happiness. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forgives her, and the two women reconcile, bond deeply over shared heartbreaks, and affirm their lasting friendship.

## CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) insist that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) take it easy and keep [Susan](../character/susan.md) on to handle the household duties. Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim visit, sharing jokes and news, including word that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), the grandson of the house's original builder, will be boarding with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) for the summer.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P3](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P11](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)_

## CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) drops [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) off at Anne's house before rushing away to an emergency. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks Owen to Leslie's home, chatting with him about his writing ambitions and connection to the area, before introducing him to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and [Dick](../character/dick.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P34](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0034)_

## CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) to Captain Jim at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, where Captain Jim shares old memories and sea tales. Learning that Owen is a writer, Captain Jim allows him to take home his prized life-book, which Owen eagerly begins reading.

## CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) gets Captain Jim's enthusiastic approval to write a novel based on his life-book and the memory of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). Owen spends a wonderful summer working on the book at the lighthouse and enjoying outings with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). By September, Owen completes the novel and prepares to end his vacation, knowing he has written something extraordinary.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018)_

## CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — While [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is away attending an emergency, [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he is deeply in love with [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) listens with sympathy and compassion, advising him that he must leave in silence. Miss Cornelia arrives, cutting through the emotional tension with her sensible humor.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P9](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 26 OWEN FORD’S CONFESSION P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)_

## CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accompanies [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the channel and encounters [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) walking alone in the foggy night on the sand-bar. Distressed over Owen Ford's departure, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) confesses her unsought love for him to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforts her without revealing Owen's true feelings, and they bring [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) home with them in their boat.

## CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and discusses funny obituaries, religious evangelists, and Owen Ford's effect on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives, and later [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shares her grief over her dog's death. After returning from a holiday trip to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) learn from Captain Jim that Owen's book based on his life story has been accepted for publication.

## CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he believes [Dick](../character/dick.md) Moore's faculties could be restored through a surgical operation and feels bound by duty to inform [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strongly protests, arguing that it would only bring more burden and misery to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), but [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) remains committed to telling the truth.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P10](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P12](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P15](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P16](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0016)_

## CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) consults Captain Jim, who surprisingly agrees that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) should be told about the possibility of an operation for [Dick](../character/dick.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) informs [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who cold-bloodedly decides to take [Dick](../character/dick.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the procedure, despite Anne's fears for her happiness. Afterwards, Miss Cornelia confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in anger over Gilbert's intervention, though she eventually accepts that the decision is made.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P30](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P48](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0048)_

## CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

**[Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), [Dick](../character/dick.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) finances and undergoes the journey to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) so [Dick](../character/dick.md) can have his operation. Later, after a successful surgery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a shocking letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) revealing that the man believed to be [Dick](../character/dick.md) is actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P8](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

## CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) the surprising details from Leslie's letter, revealing that the man thought to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) is actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), making [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) a free woman. They discuss George's past, Leslie's situation, and [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) subtly suggests informing [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) about Leslie's freedom.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P0](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P18](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0018)_

## CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md)** — [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) returns home alone and visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her garden, recounting how George Moore's sister took him home after his memory returned. She shares her feelings of numbness, loneliness, and the lingering emotional strain of deciding to proceed with the operation.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P0](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P5](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P7](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P12](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0012)_

## CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing immense joy and relief to the household after her previous loss. They decide to name the boy [James Matthew](../character/james-matthew.md), and the friends and family visit to admire the newborn while Miss Cornelia and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss Owen Ford's upcoming visit.

## CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gus](../character/gus.md), [Little Jem](../character/little-jem.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — Following an election victory for the Liberals, Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to share the political news. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the lighthouse, where she meets a newly shaved [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) and speaks with Captain Jim about his feelings on aging and mortality.

## CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Little Jem](../character/little-jem.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Susan](../character/susan.md) leaves to care for her sister after an accident, and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) moves into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to stay with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while [Susan](../character/susan.md) is away. [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) visits and meets [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) there, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tell [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) that Owen has returned to court her.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P25](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P40](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P49](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0049)_

## CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md)** — Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to share the shocking news that she is getting married to [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) playfully teases her about her past claims and gives her humorously ironic rules for managing a husband, which Miss Cornelia takes in good stride.

## CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Little Jem](../character/little-jem.md), [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) declares his love to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she joyfully returns his feelings. Later, Captain Jim joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Owen by the fireplace to share a solemn farewell and bestow a loving blessing upon them all. After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) congratulates [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with gossip about [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) Bryant's upcoming marriage.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P15](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P28](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0028)_

## CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md)** — [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) deliver Owen Ford's published life-book to Captain Jim, who hosts them for tea and celebrates the long-awaited occasion. The next morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) notice the lighthouse lamp is still lit past sunrise and hasten to investigate. They enter the lighthouse to find Captain Jim has peacefully passed away in his sleep with his life-book on his chest.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P4](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P11](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P16](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)_

## CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

**[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Little Jem](../character/little-jem.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md)** — [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes buying the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) to accommodate their growing needs, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken at the prospect of leaving her house of dreams. [Susan](../character/susan.md) welcomes the move for practical reasons, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is only comforted when [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) reveals that Owen intends to buy their current home for summer vacations. Finally, after packing up the house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bids an emotional farewell to her beloved home.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P21](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P65](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0065)_
